profile_text.body:
ClassDojo is a K-12 classroom communication platform that connects teachers with families. According to its website, it offers free classroom communication, behavior tracking, and student portfolios, and the company says it is used in 95% of US schools. Its messaging feature lets teachers, families, and staff communicate and automatically translates messages into more than 190+ languages. Stories lets teachers share photos, videos, and updates on a private feed, while Points and Big Ideas support social-emotional learning and Portfolios give students a space of their own. A Teacher Toolkit covers attendance sheets, timers, and other classroom tasks.

The site's own description places AI in the product mainly through automatic message translation. The company's materials do not otherwise detail AI systems, and the product listing notes that this information comes from third-party sources and has not been independently verified. The same listing describes the audience as teachers, families, and students, with student age and privacy practices not verified. Pricing is free for teachers, schools, and districts, with an optional ClassDojo Plus family subscription.

No lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded for the company.
